concreteHotPaths.behavior: worldContract loads every country and builds full by-ID/by-ordinal metadata+contract records. An uncached cell lookup can trigger loadAll. First metric lookup parses the entire metrics file. All accessed exact edge shards remain in the server Map. Parent membership filters a complete country each call.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: O(global cells) startup/metrics, O(accessed geometry) unbounded server exact cache; repeated O(country cells) membership scans.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Initial validation constructs all territories. A one-cell change spreads the entire territoriesById record, sharing entity objects but allocating a new global key table.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: O(global cells) per changed record; shallow sharing does not remove the full map copy.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Browser expands the complete initial runs into one entity per global ID. Each nonempty delta spreads that full record. Subsequent snapshots omit unchanged territory bodies, so network deltas are already smaller than the in-memory state.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: O(global cells) browser startup and nonempty world-delta map copy.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Every new territory record compares all IDs to derive one or a few changed cells. Runtime publish and arbitrary snapshot catch-up can call it.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: O(global cells), even when effect cap is512 and actual changed cells1.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Immutable leaf hashes are cached, but a new record materializes all entries, sorts all leaf keys and canonically encodes the complete root input.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: At least O(global cells) bytes, sorting O(N log N) in general. Cached leaves do not make the domain root update incremental.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Before bounded Dijkstra, walks every territory to discover current actor/target and eligible cells, then examines eligible target adjacency and contacts. Near-parent area calculation traverses whole parent membership.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: O(global cells + target eligible adjacency) prefix.512 limits output/traversal, not the prefix, map copies, root hashing or source decode.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Undo history retains before/after world snapshots and plans. Distinct shallow-copied global key tables remain reachable. The session versions map64 bound is not an engine-history size bound. The server permits up to8 local sessions.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: Potential O(turn history × global cells) retained key-table slots; initial immutable entities are shared, but each changed record table is distinct.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Global edge incidence and reverse incidence are initialized for the entire catalog; seenCells/seenEdges/indexedTilePaths retain visited IDs. Country metadata LRU16, decoded bytes32MiB, parsed shards4MiB/8 entries, selected-cell/edge caches4MiB each bound portions of geometry, not total worker/GPU source memory.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: O(global cells+edges) metadata. Viewport decoding still encounters full intersecting shards. Source geometry and MapLibre tile/worker memory need separate budgets.

concreteHotPaths.behavior: Topology shards currently hold up to2048 edge records, rather than a strict decoded-byte/spatial budget. Readers require exactly3 decimal shard digits. Render tiles are all explicitly indexed for zoom0–6; micro IDs remain logically represented in the overview pipeline.
concreteHotPaths.scaling: 500k mixed-model cells implies about1.64M edges/~802 shards, within3digits but near the format ceiling; >2.048M edges requires a format change. Fixed per-edge counts do not bound coordinate bytes.

prerequisites.topic: Display LOD independent of logical fine IDs
prerequisites.work: Render country/macro aggregates at world zoom, load fine fills and boundaries only at useful scales/viewport, retain exact changed/occupied cells and fronts at every needed scale. Generate all aggregate boundaries from the same authoritative partition and verify shared fill/edge coverage. Preserve macro boundaries in normal mode while micro lines stay debug-only.
prerequisites.gate: Actual world/China/dense-city/coast/border hardware and software browser frame/heap/transfer budgets; visual+tile coverage proofs.

prerequisites.work: Separate immutable source geometry/IDs/parents from owner/controller columns. Use ordinal-indexed pages or persistent chunks/sparse overrides, copying touched pages only. Update authenticated roots from touched pages. Keep revision/catalog/atomic rollback/owner-controller checks, undo/redo and preserved sessions intact.
prerequisites.gate: Real512-cell and1-cell commits plus long undo/redo histories at50k/100k/250k/500k without full-map copy or full root rebuild.

prerequisites.work: Maintain owner/controller membership and live border indexes incrementally from validated deltas; cache immutable parent membership/area totals. Restrict lookup work to relevant current fronts, not global keys. Keep distance/width/area/parent/authority512 limits unchanged.
prerequisites.gate: Existing military negative controls, stale revisions, changed controllers and bidirectional followups pass at scale; bounded visited work recorded.

prerequisites.work: Index cell/edge shards by bbox or spatial tiles and country pair; set decoded-byte/vertex caps, cancellation and backpressure. Avoid scanning all shards and avoid repeated giant coastal features. Expand shard addressing before3digit limits and keep content hashes/version isolation.
prerequisites.gate: Pan across multiple countries and coast complexity under an explicit network/decoded-memory budget; no national whole-geometry request.

prerequisites.topic: Paged initial snapshots and session persistence
prerequisites.work: Deliver compact ordinal state and catalog mapping pages/range manifests rather than every full hash ID and JS entity upfront. Retain source country and owner/controller separately. Persist structural chunks/checkpoints and deltas so session/history cost does not multiply full global maps.
prerequisites.gate: Cold/warm startup,8 session capacity, long-run checkpoint+restore, catalog coexistence and old-game continuity tested with exact pins.

prerequisites.topic: Country source programme and incremental validation
prerequisites.work: Research each country vintage/hierarchy/IDs/CRS/license separately; preserve current country masks and fine neighbours; independently verify seams/residuals, raw replay and delivery. Dense cities, sparse counties, islands and coast complexity need different natural unit choices rather than identical ADM labels or cell quotas.
prerequisites.gate: No247-times-China assumption, no uniform-source historical claim; publish only immutable per-country candidates with source-specific proof.

decisionByPlanningSize.assessment: Plausible engineering pilot after state/index/LOD work; current unchanged object-copy/root paths already show meaningful capacity cost. Not certified as playable by the metadata benchmark.
Current architecture should not be rolled out unchanged; measured metadata copy and root lower-bound are already roughly100ms and140ms separately on this host.

Requires paged/indexed state, true display aggregation and bounded spatial delivery before geographic integration; metadata-only copy265ms and root lower-bound436ms do not include rendering or full validation.
Longer-term capacity target only. No actual500k fixture/browser/turn was run; package/coordinate/state estimates identify planning bounds, not a runtime guarantee.
